title: Withholding Tax for Employee
summary: Withholding tax support for employee transactions has been added, allowing users to calculate and track employee-related withholding taxes similar to existing purchase-based functionality with new employee setup tables, calculation logic, and ledger entries.
key_points: New employee withholding tax feature with setup tables including groups, group lines, and threshold accumulators
Employee withholding calculation codeunit for transaction processing and subscriber patterns
Extended employee card and employee ledger entry to support withholding tax tracking
Withholding tax posting setup extended to support both purchase and expense transactions
Permission sets updated to include new employee-related withholding tax objects
